correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of \(\Phi\) along the printed vector field cancels \(-aw\) with \(a\dot z\), the \(exy\) term with the derivative of \(-(e/2)x^2\), and \(fxz\) with the matching component of \(-f\,d(xy)/dt\), leaving exactly \(bx^2-(c+f)y^2+g\). A bounded forward state makes \(\Phi(T)-\Phi(0)\) uniformly bounded, so division by \(T\) gives the time-average law. Invariance of a compactly supported probability measure gives the stationary law by integrating the time-integrated identity. The sign cases follow immediately, and the source decimal parameters reduce exactly to coefficients \(35/99\) and \(115/198\). The inspected symbolic verifier independently checks the polynomial identity and rational specialization.
